findings.description: Elio María Méndez married Domitila Castro on 3 July 1924 in Santa Bárbara, Guaraque, Mérida, Venezuela; the civil registration names her parents as Vicente Castro and Rosalina Rosalez.

details.place: Santa Bárbara, Guaraque, Guaraque, Mérida, Venezuela

supporting_sources: Venezuela, Registro Civil, 1843-2021 — marriage entry for Elio María Méndez and Domitila Castro, 3 de julio de 1924 (ark:/61903/1:1:XSX4-1KWV)

findings.description: Elio María Méndez was the son of Ángel Méndez and Magdalena Luna, as named on his 1924 marriage registration.
supporting_sources: Venezuela, Registro Civil, 1843-2021 — marriage entry for Elio María Méndez and Domitila Castro, 3 de julio de 1924, naming his parents Ángel Méndez and Magdalena Luna (ark:/61903/1:1:XSX4-1KWV)
